subject: Coupa enrollment: signer routing & PO-ack SLA for MedSupply
messages:
From: Laura Nash <laura.nash@medsupply.co>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medsupply.co, portal-support@medsupply.co
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coupa enrollment: signer mapping and PO-ack SLA

Hi Jonas —

Thanks again for walking us through the Coupa onboarding steps yesterday. Two items surfaced in our internal ops review that we need clarified before we enable automated PO routing: 

1) PO acknowledgment SLA — your docs say "ACK within 24h" but our procurement policy requires 4 business-hour ACKs for high-priority SKUs. Can Redwood support a shorter ACK window for a subset of POs?

2) Signer routing — we use a multi-tier signatory matrix. Can you confirm who Redwood sends signature requests to when an order hits the $250k threshold and whether we can map by business unit (North vs. South)?

I've attached our PO_Ack_Spec_v2.pdf and a sample signatory matrix. Please let me know if you need any legal redlines up front — happy to share.

Best,
Laura Nash
Director, ProcureOps
MedSupply Co.

Attachments: PO_Ack_Spec_v2.pdf
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Laura Nash <laura.nash@medsupply.co>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa enrollment: signer mapping and PO-ack SLA

Laura — thanks for the note and the specs, very helpful. Short answers up front: 

- ACK SLA: We can make a per-account ACK target but need to lock in the tradeoff with throughput. For a 4-hour ACK on a subset of high-priority SKUs we can set a priority queue and reserved capacity policy under a Dedicated plan or via a routing rule on Hosted that pins to higher tier instances. I'll loop legal/ops to confirm any contractual SLA language.

- Signer routing: The portal supports mapping by order amount and business unit. However, mapping to multiple signer roles (e.g., business approval + finance sign-off for $250k+) requires a signer-routing CSV that we ingest — I'll attach a template (Signer_Route_Map.csv).

Looping in Kim (ops) and Mateo (legal) to confirm what we need contractually to commit to a 4-hour ACK and to review any MSA/order form redlines.

Next step: Mateo, can you confirm whether we can accept a 4-hour ACK for a scoped SKU list as an addendum to the order form (vs. changing MSA SLA language)?

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, Laura Nash <laura.nash@medsupply.co>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa enrollment: signer mapping and PO-ack SLA

On Fri, Jul 30, 2027 at 5:03 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Mateo, can you confirm whether we can accept a 4-hour ACK for a scoped SKU list as an addendum to the order form (vs. changing MSA SLA language)?

Hi all — quick legal take: we prefer not to change core MSA SLA tables for account-specific operational preferences. Two options that are contractually cleaner and lower-risk: 

1) Order-form addendum: Add a short clause in the order form referencing the SKU list and a defined "Priority PO ACK" SLA (e.g., 4 business hours). This keeps the MSA intact and makes the obligation scoped and time-limited. We'll need: named SKU list (or SKU tags), geographic scope, and the effective period.

2) Service Attachment: If MedSupply wants this as a long-term commitment, we can draft a Service Attachment with performance credits for missed ACKs. That requires sign-off from Revenue Ops and Legal and adds billing/credit clauses.

Regarding signer routing: we can accept the signer-routing mapping as an attachment to the order form. Ops (Kim) — we'll need the CSV validated against Redwood's mapping schema. I flagged a couple of standard redlines in the attached MedSupply_MSA_Redlines.docx that ask for clarity on breach remedies tied to SLA credits — Laura, that's optional for the addendum route but expected if you select the Service Attachment route.

I'll take point on a one-page order-form addendum draft if you want to go that route. Can you send the SKU list and confirm which business units need per-unit mapping?

—Mateo
Senior Legal Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedSupply_MSA_Redlines.docx
From: Laura Nash <laura.nash@medsupply.co>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@medsupply.co, portal-support@medsupply.co
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa enrollment: signer mapping and PO-ack SLA

Thanks Mateo — order-form addendum sounds like the best path for us. We'll provide: 

- SKU list (CSV) by EOD Thursday 8/5
- Business unit mapping (North, South, Central) — will use the routing tags you supplied
- Confirmation that 4-hour ACK applies only to SKUs flagged as "Priority"; others remain standard 24h ACK

Action items we see today: 
- MedSupply to send SKU CSV and tag mapping (Laura) — due 2027-08-05 EOD
- Redwood legal to produce one-page order-form addendum draft (Mateo) — target 2027-08-06
- Ops to validate signer-routing CSV and confirm ingestion window (Kim) — target 2027-08-04

We'll also start an internal approval for the short addendum (procurement + finance). Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Laura
Director, ProcureOps
MedSupply Co.

Cc: procurement@medsupply.co
